chapter: Package shows, Miami and the USO
title: Delicate Pines in Miami Beach
summary: A five-month job in a floor show at a Miami club.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Did you make any money with her?
I made some nice money. We got all the way down to Miami Beach and they offered me this job, a very fine job, at a place called Delicate Pines.
Yes. It had about twenty people in the show, a fag half the show, two bands, a fag half went on and then we played for the legitimate show and I stayed there for about five months.
It was December of '49 when we left.
You left Boston in December of '49 to start the tour?
And the tour lasted, how long would you say the tour lasted?
The tour lasted about three months. And then I stayed for about four months in Miami Beach.
So that would bring you up to the summer of '50, July or August of 1950.
I would say July or August of 1950; right.
